title: Extensionality on lifted wedges
statement: morphisms out of the tensor of exterior powers agree when they agree on wedges of locally lifted quotient sections.

proof.text: Construct the local map from the local splitting and exterior-power basis statements, then glue it by sheaf extensionality and separatedness.

mathlib_searches.query: top exterior power of a locally free sheaf is invertible
top exterior power of a finite locally free sheaf is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B C D : X.Modules}
    (g : B ⟶ C) [Epi g] (r s : ℕ)
    (φ ψ : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s ⟶ D)
    (h : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)),
      φ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i)))) =
        ψ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i))))) :
    φ = ψ
